verdict.rationale: MotherDuck Flights is a first-party feature for scheduled background automation: it runs Python jobs on a schedule for ingest, transformation and operational tasks, and the product handles runtime, scheduling, secrets, logging and versioning. It is also positioned for agent-built jobs deployed into MotherDuck. Saved Dives that stay current with data add some ongoing background behaviour. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of trigger types, failure handling and monitoring; independent or hands-on corroboration of Flights running autonomously.
